name: nz-openbank-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Akahu open-finance API (NZ). 14 tools, read-only by default, runs locally over stdio.
long_description: Ask your AI assistant about your New Zealand bank accounts through Akahu open finance, using a Personal App you control. Runs locally over stdio, starts read-only, and asks before every write. Unofficial; not affiliated with Akahu or any bank.

tools.name: acct_list_accounts
tools.description: Every connected account, with account numbers and balances

tools.name: acct_get_account_balance
tools.description: Just the balance of one account

tools.name: acct_refresh_all_accounts
tools.description: Ask Akahu to fetch fresh data for every account (write)

tools.name: acct_refresh_account
tools.description: Ask Akahu to fetch fresh data for one account (write)

tools.name: txn_get_transactions
tools.description: Settled transactions filtered by account, dates, category or amount

tools.name: txn_search_transactions
tools.description: Text search over description and merchant

tools.name: txn_report_transaction_issue
tools.description: Open a support ticket with Akahu about a transaction (write)

tools.name: id_verify_name
tools.description: Check a name against the account holder (write, extra scope)

akahu_read_only.title: Read-only mode
akahu_read_only.description: Refuse all write tools when 'true'. Leave as 'true' unless you specifically need refresh/verify/report writes.

akahu_automation_bypass.title: Automation bypass
akahu_automation_bypass.description: Skip per-call consent prompts for safe-to-automate writes (account refresh only). Requires read-only=false.

akahu_mask_accounts.title: Mask account numbers
akahu_mask_accounts.description: When 'true', account numbers show only the bank code, last four digits and suffix. Default 'false' shows them in full. Transaction descriptions are never masked.
